name: AR Shoppe Unlimited
teaser: We need guns. Lots of guns.  Everything you could ever want to build an AR. Thousands of parts, reasonable prices. Extremely spicy presets.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
You want it, we’ve got it. Every single AR derived part in one neat little shop that sells for dollars and buys for dollars.

I resurrected Kugel’s legendary AR-Shoppe mod, and improved it, adding compatibility for every single AR derived mod, as well as all the AR derived parts in game.

There’s not much more to say, if it works with an M4, HK-416, Sig MPX or MCX, etc, it’s here. I promise you won’t be disappointed.

Mod Compatibilities:

Shop contains all the parts for the following mods:

Carl’s Blackout Expansion - 1 preset ARBlackout with great stats

Carl’s Q Honey Badger - 2 presets, one with great stats, one that’s just default

Carl’s STAR15 - 1 preset for sniping

Mira’s M16A4 - all parts, but no presets, they live in Peacekeeper level 1

Thunderbag’s Full Auto STM, two presets - one for CQC, one for snipes

You do not need to install the above mods to use this mod, they merely provide a little extra sauce for an already overstocked shop.
